SELECT c.conversation_id , c.status , m.label AS menu_label , c.user_id , c.assigned_admin_id , c.last_message_at , c.created_at , (SELECT msg.content FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY msg.message_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content , (SELECT msg.sender_type FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY msg.message_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_sender_type FROM chat_conversation c LEFT JOIN chat_menu m ON m.menu_id = c.menu_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY (c.status IN ('WAITING_AGENT', 'AI_ANSWERED')) DESC, c.last_message_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation c WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation WHERE status IN ('WAITING_AGENT', 'AI_ANSWERED')

SELECT m.label AS menu_label , COUNT(c.conversation_id) AS conversation_count , SUM(c.status IN ('WAITING_AGENT', 'AI_ANSWERED')) AS waiting_count , SUM(c.ai_answer_count > 0) AS ai_answered_count , AVG( (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.created_at, a.created_at) FROM chat_message a WHERE a.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND a.sender_type = 'AGENT' ORDER BY a.message_id LIMIT 1) ) AS avg_first_response_seconds FROM chat_menu m LEFT JOIN chat_conversation c ON c.menu_id = m.menu_id AND c.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.label ORDER BY conversation_count DESC, m.display_order
SELECT m.label FROM chat_conversation c JOIN chat_menu m ON m.menu_id = c.menu_id WHERE c.conversation_id = #{conversationId}
